## User problem

Describe the task, current behavior, and what prevents completion.

## Proposed behavior

Give a concrete before/after example. Identify the Codex CLI, hook, skill, or
installer surface involved and how success could be checked.

## Existing options and constraints

Describe existing commands or workarounds you tried. Include relevant platform,
permission, ownership, offline, or compatibility requirements. Do not include
credentials or private repository content.
